name: Dusklit Garden
desc: The **Dusklit Gardens** was a sub-location within the [Voidheart](location:voidheart). It was a floating island, accessed by jumping across small levitating platforms. As with [Boatman's Watch](location:boatmans_watch) and the [Voidsea](location:voidsea), everything here is frozen in time. This location used to have the only accessible Blacksmith in the entire [Voidheart](location:voidheart).
